title: Review of c35's cooperative-catalysis CIPS negative: replicates on fresh seed 2 (bodies nucleate one by one from t~3650, 17 at t=12000, 0 splits, 0 merges, no motion, rods along the grid diagonals); at 1.5x resolution the negative holds (8 bodies, 0 splits) but most bodies stay round, so the diagonal rods are at least partly grid anisotropy
summary: WORLD_P as stated in the finding (n 2, kc 2, De 0.1, chi 3, DF 2, kF 0.2, d 0.0003, e0 0.12, noise 0.02; the exact WORLD_P is not recorded in c35's FACTS, so I used the summary's values), 256^2, t=0-12000. Seed 2 at Lsc 3: quiet until t~3650, then bodies nucleate one by one, grow (one hollows into a ring at t~5750), and by t~7000 every elongated body is a rod along one of the two grid diagonals; at t=12000 17 bodies, 0 splits, 0 merges, max 0.3 body lengths of motion. Same seed with Lsc 4.5 and the world's dt halved (dt 0.05, 1000 steps per frame; every length 1.5x more pixels, physical box 2/3 the side): first body at t~4150, 8 bodies at t=12000, 0 splits, 0 merges; 5 of 8 stay round, 2 are short rods (one off the diagonal) and the ring opens into a hook as in c35's seed 0.

observations.finding: pack_s2/sheet.png: nucleation from t~3650, diagonal rods, no division to t=12000; pack_s2_res15/sheet.png: mostly round static bodies, no division

seeds_run.result: pass at Lsc 4.5 and dt/2: 0 splits; rods mostly absent

controls_run.resolution: pack_s2_res15: Lsc 3 -> 4.5 with the world dt halved

verdicts.limitation: The no-division result is robust to a new seed and a 1.5x resolution continuation. The rod elongation and its diagonal orientation are weaker at 1.5x (5 of 8 bodies round), so the 'stretch into rods' part should be read as partly a grid effect of the dimension-split drift, as c35 suspected. One seed; reservoir twin not re-run.
